verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way. The hero phone, which is the key image, is shrunk to a tiny unreadable thumbnail in the bottom gutter. A big empty brown photo panel takes up half the canvas. The circle has come loose from the phone and now sits behind the headline and CTA, so white text lands on a mid-tone circle and the original's clean text-on-solid-panel layout is lost. B is worse. Its headline runs right up against the photo panel's edge with no gutter. The headline wraps into four lines and leaves 'nights' orphaned. Its phone is even smaller and jammed against the photo's corner. A at least keeps the three-line headline wrap and a little breathing room.
